Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
STRIPPel^, FASCIA 



( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements of fascia stripper used In surgery, 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. I.

FIG. I STRIPPER. FASCIA 



3. Materials 

3.1 Working End and Stem — Stainless steel, conforming to Designation 30Crl3 of Schedule V of IS: 1570- 
1961 'Schedules for wrought steels for general engineering purposes'. 

3.2 Handles — Stainless steel, conforming to Designation 30Crl3 or brass. 

4. Worlcmanship and Finish 

4.1 All surfaces of the stripper except the cutting e<(ges, shall be finished smooth and shall be free from 
craclcs, pits, seams, burrs and other surface flaws. 

4.2 Handle shall be hollow and shall be provided with suitable grooves for good hold. It shall be securely 
fitted to the stem. The brazing or sliver soldering for handle joint shall be neatly finished. 

43 The cutting edges shall be sharp and shall be free from nicks, feathers and other flaws. 

4.4 The opening in the working end shall be of rectangular section as shown in Fig. I. 

4.5 The stainless steel parts shall be passivated and polished bright, 

4.6 if the handie Is made of brass, it shall be plated chromium over nickel and the plating shall conform to 
Service Grade No. 2 of IS : 4827-1968 * Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium pn 
copper and copper alloys '. 

5. Heat Treatment — The stem and working end shall be heat-treated together. The hardness of the 
cutting edges of the working end shall be 550 to 600 HV. The hardness of stem shall be not less than 
440H^. 

i. Test 

6.1 Flexibility Test — Hold the instrument by Its handle firmly In a vice so that the entire item projects 
outside the vice horizontally. Deflect the working end of the Instrument in horizontal plane by 5& mm and 
release. The working end shall, on release, return to its normal position and shall not take a new perma- 
nent set.

6.2 Test for Cutting Edges — Take a long strip of chrome leather 0*5 to Oo mm thick, Siic up a width 
suitable for the opening in the working end of the stripper. Introduce the slit up portion into the 
working end so as to locate the opposite pair of cutting edges on the slits. By holding the free end of the 
inserted portion between the index finger and the thumb of the left hand, push the instrument forward 
with the right hand. The cutting edges shall be deemed to be satisfactory if they cut out a continuous 
length of leather strip in a uniform manner. 

6.3 Corrosion Resistance Test for Stainless Steel Parts — Scrub the sample with soap and warm water, rinse 
in hot water, and dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the sample. Immerse in copper sulphate solution 
at room temperature for 6 minutes and wash off with fresh water or wet cotton wool. 

Make up the copper sulphate solution as follows: 

Copper sulphate ( CuS04*5H20 ) 4*0 g 

Sulphuric acid ( HsSO*) ( sp gr 1*84 ) 10*0 g 

Distilled water [see IS: 1070-1960 Specification 900 ml 
for water, distilled quality (reWsed)] 

No redistain or spots on the sample shall be allowed but dulling of the polished surface may be 
permitted. 

7. Marking — Mark with the following : 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) Words ' Stainless Steel * on the stem. 

8. Packing — Wrap in moisture-proof paper and pack In polyethylene bags avoiding contact with one 
another. The cutting edges shall be suitably protected. The packing may also be done as agreed to be- 
tween the purchaser and the supplier
